Diagnostic Center Token and Report Delivery

Patients ask when reports are ready. Staff need token control, payment status, and delivery proof.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 15,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 1,000Recommended monthly charge

BDT 1,000/month is realistic because each center handles many patients and support needs are higher.

8.1Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 15,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 1,000Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 8,100,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target small diagnostic centers and collection points that need token, sample, report-ready, and delivery tracking without a large hospital system.

Report status calls waste time and patients return too early or too late.

Patients know report status without calling again and again.

Validation signals

  • Private diagnostic centers are widespread.
  • Report-ready status is a repeated daily question.
  • Centers can pay more than micro shops.
  • Token systems reduce desk pressure.

MVP modules

  • Token generation
  • Test list
  • Payment due
  • Sample collected status
  • Report ready status
  • SMS/WhatsApp-ready message
  • Daily test report

Do not build first

  • Do not build lab-machine integration first.
  • Do not store complex medical records first.
  • Do not promise regulatory compliance.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Data sensitivity.
  • Custom test pricing.
  • Staff workflow mismatch.
Mitigations
  • Minimal patient data.
  • Configurable test list.
  • Observe desk workflow before coding extras.
